title: Three Christmases and One Short Bone
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：ham　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ham 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the cook ① carved the ham that no guest in the house would have described, and he said the carving was the whole of the Christmas. The ② ham, meaning the joint itself and not the bone, ran three Christmases and stayed undescribed in the book; ham, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of ham in that house had the same short bone beside it, and the ④ ham at the far table, meaning the joint they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Ham, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the cook said the describing is the part that fills three Christmases.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ham was the whole of the matter, meaning the flavour and not the joint. The ⑥ ham, meaning the flavour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; ham, he said, is either something you carve or the only word that means both a joint and a flavour. He said the flavour is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ ham had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short bone. The ⑧ ham of the whole thing, the cook wrote in November, was one house and three Christmases of describing; ham, he said, is either the joint at the far table or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ham I remember is the ham described in the list, which closed in 1979 and is still described as the quietest in the house. ⑩ Ham, my mother said in 1981, is the only joint that improves by being described; all ham, she said, is a flavour that has agreed to look like a joint. She said the flavour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 火腿（指屋里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 火腿（指那只腿肉本身，与骨头相对）
C. 固定搭配：carve the ham 切火腿
D. n. 火腿（指留给孩子们学着切的那一块）
E. n. 火腿（抽象总称，指一座屋子的火腿之事）
F. n. 火腿（指清单里写到、被称过的那些）
G. n. 后腿；腿肉（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 腿肉（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: carved the ham that no guest in the house would have described
The ham, meaning the joint itself and not the bone
Every kind of ham in that house
the ham at the far table
the ham was the whole of the matter

answers.why: carve the ham 意为“切火腿”，1972 年那位厨师切了屋子里没有一位客人肯描述的火腿。
ham 意为“火腿”，指那只腿肉本身而不是骨头，它经过了三个圣诞节而在簿子上没有被描述。
ham 意为“火腿”，指屋里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一根矮矮的骨头。
ham 意为“火腿”，指最远那张桌上留给孩子们学着切的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ham 意为“后腿、腿肉”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块腿肉就是那件事的全部。
ham 意为“腿肉”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些火腿，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ham 意为“火腿”，指清单里写到、被称过的那些，到 1977 年这些成了清单里的一行。
ham 意为“火腿”，厨师十一月写道，整件事的火腿之事是一座屋子和三个圣诞节的描述。
ham 意为“火腿”，我记得的是清单里描述过的那些，1979 年吃完了，至今仍被说成屋里最安静的一批。
ham 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，火腿是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的腿肉。
